title: ASTRA: AI SAFETY, TRUST, & RISK ASSESSMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures using a Grounded Theory approach, specifically examining credit scoring models that reproduce historic exclusion by encoding upper-caste financial behavior as a default.

Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures, evaluating skewed training data in education systems and credit models that penalize minority-concentrated districts or reject applicants based on Muslim names.
Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures, analyzing disparities in fintech lending models and educational platform feedback caused by training on male-dominated data.

Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures, assessing the exclusion of regional-language learners by AI tutors and speech recognition (ASR) systems misreading tribal dialects.

Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures, evaluating the lack of support for visually and hearing-impaired students and mistranslations arising from low-resource languages.
Compilation and thematic analysis of documented real-world AI failures, examining models that misread rural/seasonal cash flows and systems that red-line specific geographic regions as high-risk.
